title: Eric Davis says the head of crash retrieval refused to talk
summary: Eric Davis tells of Eric Davis says the head of crash retrieval refused to talk, about 2000s at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us.

plain: Eric Davis, a scientist who has worked on US government studies of unexplained craft, says that in the 2000s he and his colleagues tried to interview the man running a crash retrieval program, meaning a secret effort to recover crashed craft of unknown origin, linked in the telling to a man named Glenn Gaffney. According to Davis, that person refused to talk to them. If true, it would mean such a program existed and had a leader who was keeping it from even other insiders.
